contea di ritrovamento: Telford and Wrekin (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP LICINIVS PF AVG ; R/ SOLI INVICTO COMITI

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Licinius I (AD307-318). Reece period 15, Sear no. 3706. Reverse: SOLI INVICTO COMITI. Obverse: Cuirassed and laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP LICINIVS PF AVG. Reverse: Sol standing left holding globe. Reverse inscription: SOLI INVICTO COMITI. Mint mark: S/F//blank. Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: Diameter: 19.16mm; weight: 2.20g. Reference: Sear, D R. 1970. Roman Coins and Their Values. Seaby, London. P. 310
